question.prompt: Name an alien character or alien species from a film, TV show or video game.
question.criteria: Any named fictional extraterrestrial character or species appearing in a released film, television show or video game counts.

answers.evidence: E.T. is the stranded alien befriended by Elliott in E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.
Yoda is an alien Jedi Master in Star Wars.
Chewbacca is a Wookiee and Han Solo's copilot in Star Wars.
Stitch is a genetically engineered alien in Lilo & Stitch.
Superman is a hero from the planet Krypton who appears in numerous films, television shows and games.
Xenomorphs are the extraterrestrial creatures featured in the Alien franchise.
Predators are extraterrestrial hunters featured in the Predator franchise.
Klingons are an extraterrestrial species in Star Trek.
Vulcans are a Star Trek species known for their commitment to logic.
Daleks are alien mutants housed in armored machines in Doctor Who.
Ewoks are the small, furry inhabitants of the forest moon of Endor in Star Wars.
Groot is a tree-like alien member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
Marvin the Martian is an alien character in Looney Tunes cartoons.
The asari are an alien species in the Mass Effect games.
The protoss are a technologically advanced alien species in StarCraft.
The zerg are an alien swarm in StarCraft.
Sangheili are the alien species commonly called Elites in Halo.
The hanar are a jellyfish-like alien species in Mass Effect.
The elcor are a large, four-legged alien species in Mass Effect.
Spock is a half-human, half-Vulcan Starfleet officer in Star Trek.
Time Lords are the alien civilization from Gallifrey to which the Doctor belongs in Doctor Who.
Alf is an alien from Melmac who lives with a human household in the sitcom ALF.
Turians are an alien species in the Mass Effect games.
The Na'vi are the humanoid inhabitants of Pandora in the Avatar films.
The Thermians are the aliens who seek help from television actors in Galaxy Quest.

question.explanation: Science fiction has introduced countless aliens, from friendly visitors and intergalactic heroes to entire civilizations and extraterrestrial monsters.
